name: Survey tile in Cetus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cetus, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 8 visits over 65 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2026-06-29, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
